note: One entry per publishable image. .github/workflows/publish-image.yml builds each workload kit from its v3 descriptor (docker buildx build -f <dir>/<descriptor> <dir>) and pushes docker.io/nikcio/<name>:v<release> (plus :latest) when a release is published (requires DOCKERHUB_USERNAME + DOCKERHUB_TOKEN repo secrets). The workloads build their stack toolchain directly on the unversioned shell base image. Mixins are not published as images — they are consumed as git references (see examples/*.sbxenv.yaml). The release-please extra-files blocks keep every versioned reference (kit version fields, example refs) at the release version.
